### Code Snippets

```
ALTER TABLE Persons
ADD CONSTRAINT PK_Person PRIMARY KEY (ID,LastName);

---

ALTER TABLE Persons
DROP CONSTRAINT UC_Person;

---

ALTER TABLE Persons
DROP INDEX UC_Person;

---

---

---

ALTER TABLE Orders

---

ALTER TABLE Orders
DROP FOREIGN KEY FK_PersonOrder;

---

ALTER TABLE Persons
DROP CONSTRAINT CHK_PersonAge;

---

ALTER TABLE Persons
DROP CHECK CHK_PersonAge;
```
